comment: Classification of the project's headless suites for the Linux gate (tools/test-linux.sh). portable: the same source runs on Windows and Linux. linux_specific: only meaningful on Linux. windows_specific: needs a Windows header, DLL or device and is covered only by tools/test.ps1; a pass there proves nothing about Linux. runtime_only: no headless suite can prove it; it is tested by running the program.

windows_specific.audio_tests: includes windows.h (DirectSound ABI against the Windows SDK)
windows_specific.input_tests: includes windows.h and the lifted input path
windows_specific.presentation_tests: needs JPT_SOURCE_DIR and the Windows source list
windows_specific.water_tests: includes windows.h and the lifted water code

runtime_only: SDL3 window, fullscreen and presentation on a real display
keyboard, mouse and gamepad on real devices
audio through PipeWire, PulseAudio or ALSA
New Game, Beach, gameplay, minimap, subtitles
Save and Load, level transition, shutdown
